lines.text: Ferrymen. Halvard recovery patrol. Drop the salvage and walk. That is an order, not a trade.
Unmoored. Directorate recovery zone. Keep away from the compute crates. Your terminal does not give you a claim here.
Halvard recovery. Salvage in this ring is Directorate property. Drop it and walk.
Ferrymen get the hull. Halvard gets the compute. That's not a deal; it's an order.
